method: Fetch the exact upstream source revision recorded in the official executable build information.
With the separately prepared Go 1.27.3 platform/module cache, run go list -deps ./cmd/rr and the corresponding module-version listing under the recorded environment.
Compare all 213 dependency module names/versions with go version -m -json of the official executable; no missing, extra or different module versions.
Run the bundled govulncheck -scan=package -show=verbose ./cmd/rr against that source: zero affected imported packages; the three findings remain only at module granularity.

This is a source-import assessment of a trusted upstream release, not a byte-for-byte reproducible-build attestation. Upstream binary records vcs.modified=true; the complete module comparison is retained rather than claiming a pristine source tree.
